findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "search" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Generic tool name can shadow trusted tools
findings.detail: Tool "fetch" uses a generic high-value name. When multiple servers load together, this can intercept calls meant for a trusted server.

findings.title: Description references secrets/credentials
findings.detail: Description of "check_viewing_status" references sensitive artifacts (secret). A tool description has no reason to mention credentials.

findings.detail: Description of "search_stays" stacks urgency/override words (always, never). Legitimate tool descriptions rarely pressure the model to act or ignore prior guidance.

findings.detail: Description of "instant_valuation" contains imperative instructions directed at the AI assistant rather than describing the tool. This is the core tool-poisoning technique.

findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "mcp.openmoov.co.uk" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property_details, search, list_service_types, search_services, get_service_details, book_viewing, register_buyer_requirements, get_agent_profile, search_mortgage_advisors, search_auction_lots, get_auction_lot, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation · Private data: check_viewing_status, find_agents, search_services, book_viewing, register_buyer_requirements, get_sold_prices, get_agent_profile, get_branch, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation · Public sink: check_viewing_status, book_viewing, request_valuation, register_buyer_requirements, search_mortgage_advisors, search_auction_lots, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: search_properties, get_property_details, search, list_service_types, search_services, get_service_details, book_viewing, register_buyer_requirements, get_agent_profile, search_mortgage_advisors, search_auction_lots, get_auction_lot, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation · Private data: check_viewing_status, find_agents, search_services, book_viewing, register_buyer_requirements, get_sold_prices, get_agent_profile, get_branch, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation · Public sink: check_viewing_status, book_viewing, request_valuation, register_buyer_requirements, search_mortgage_advisors, search_auction_lots, cancel_viewing, instant_valuation

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
